techniques.name: kooplearn (Scikit-Learn Compatible Library for Evolution Operator Learning)
techniques.capability_enabled: Unified scikit-learn-compatible library to learn Koopman/Transfer operators and infinitesimal generators from data via linear, kernel, and deep-learning (neural-network Koopman embedding) estimators with spectral decomposition; enables data-driven forecasting of nonlinear dynamics
techniques.code_evidence: Explicit GitHub repo https://github.com/Machine-Learning-Dynamical-Systems/kooplearn plus PyPI install ('pip install kooplearn'), readthedocs documentation, and a Releases page; representation-learning losses implemented in both PyTorch and JAX
techniques.verbatim_quote: kooplearn is a Python library to learn evolution operators — also known as Koopman or Transfer operators — from data. It is easy to use and strictly adheres to the scikit-learn API.

techniques.name: MASF: Measurement-Aware Score-based Filter (Rethinking Forward Processes for Score-Based Data Assimilation in High Dimensions)
techniques.capability_enabled: Score-based filter for high-dimensional nonlinear data assimilation/state estimation that builds a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation, giving an analytically tractable (exact for linear) likelihood score and lower compute than ensemble Kalman filters
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link found in search results; abstract/HTML/PDF only
techniques.verbatim_quote: MASF defines a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation, which is exact for linear measurement operators and provides a principled approximation for nonlinear operators.

techniques.name: Score Filter Enhanced Data Assimilation Framework for Data-Driven Dynamical Systems (EnSF hybrid DA-training)
techniques.capability_enabled: Hybrid data-assimilation + ML-training framework using the training-free Ensemble Score Filter (a diffusion-model DA approach) to reduce predictive uncertainty and improve long-term forecasting of high-dimensional nonlinear data-driven dynamical systems
techniques.code_evidence: No official repo for this paper in results; only a related project (sda by Rozet, and ld-ensf) surfaced, not this work's code
techniques.verbatim_quote: It applies the Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF), a generative AI-based training-free diffusion model approach, for solving the data assimilation problem in high-dimensional nonlinear complex systems.

techniques.name: Inverse problems with diffusion models: MAP estimation via mode-seeking loss (VML)
techniques.capability_enabled: Zero-shot / plug-and-play solving of arbitrary (linear and nonlinear) inverse problems using a pre-trained unconditional diffusion model, via a variational mode-seeking loss whose per-step minimization steers samples toward the MAP estimate (analytic for linear inverse problems)
techniques.code_evidence: No GitHub/code link in results; arXiv abstract/PDF and OpenReview forum only
techniques.verbatim_quote: The paper introduces the variational mode-seeking loss (VML) and shows that its minimization at each reverse diffusion step guides the generated sample towards the MAP estimate.

techniques.name: FlowDA: Accurate, Low-Latency Weather Data Assimilation via Flow Matching
techniques.capability_enabled: Flow-matching (score/diffusion-adjacent generative) approach to weather-scale data assimilation / atmospheric state estimation with low latency
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link surfaced in search results (title/HTML only)
techniques.verbatim_quote: FlowDA: Accurate, Low-Latency Weather Data Assimilation via Flow Matching

techniques.name: Koopman Autoencoders with Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics for Fluid Dynamics Forecasting (Scaling Continuous-Time Koopman Autoencoders)
techniques.capability_enabled: Continuous-time Koopman autoencoder with a parameter-conditioned linear latent generator enabling exact latent evolution via matrix exponentiation for high-dimensional fluid-dynamics forecasting
techniques.code_evidence: Search explicitly noted no GitHub/code link found for this paper
techniques.verbatim_quote: arXiv:2602.02832 titled "Koopman Autoencoders with Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics for Fluid Dynamics Forecasting," which proposes a continuous-time Koopman autoencoder with latent dynamics governed by a parameter-conditioned linear generator that enables exact latent evolution via matrix exponentiation.

techniques.name: CT-KAE: Continuous-Time Koopman Approach for Ocean State Forecasting
techniques.capability_enabled: Continuous-time Koopman autoencoder projecting nonlinear (ocean/quasi-geostrophic) dynamics into a latent space governed by a linear ODE, giving resolution-invariant forecasting with bounded long-rollout error via matrix exponential
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link in search results
techniques.verbatim_quote: This approach projects nonlinear dynamics into a latent space governed by a linear ordinary differential equation, enabling temporally resolution-invariant forecasting via a matrix exponential formulation.

techniques.name: Comprehensive Robust Dynamic Mode Decomposition (CR-DMD)

notes: FERTILITY: Both subfields are fertile for FRESH papers in the 2512-2605 window; 11 fresh candidates banked across A and B. USABLE CODE: only kooplearn (2512.21409) had explicit code/weights evidence (GitHub repo + 'pip install kooplearn' + readthedocs + Releases + PyTorch/JAX losses) -> has_usable_code:true. All other 10 are research papers where WebSearch surfaced arXiv abstract/HTML/PDF only with NO code link; several search blocks explicitly stated no GitHub repo was found (2604.02889 MASF, 2603.14863, 2512.10524, 2602.02832, 2601.11116). Marked them has_usable_code:false honestly rather than guess. FRESHNESS REJECTS (seen but discarded, prefix out of {2512,2601,2602,2603,2604,2605,2606}): 2511.20612 (Stochastic Neural DMD, Nov 2025 -> reject), 2510.19971 (Guiding diffusion flow-field reconstruction, Oct 2025 -> reject despite a search snippet mislabeling it 'January 2026'; arXiv prefix 2510 governs), 2409.00230 (spatially-aware diffusion, 2024), 2504.18720 (Appa, 2025), 2401.05932 (DiffDA, 2024), 2506.09193 (LaDCast, 2025), 2505.23017 (K2VAE, 2025), 2507.01117 (DMD neural operator, 2025), 2502.05994/2504.07437/2410.00083 (2024-2025 diffusion-inverse works), 2411.19305 (LD-EnSF, 2024). DEDUP: did NOT add SGNO 2602.18801 (excluded per instructions). NOTE on dates: a couple of search summaries verbally attached wrong calendar months to IDs (e.g., calling 2510.19971 'January 2026', 2604.02889 'April 2026' which is consistent); arxiv_date fields above are derived strictly from the YYMM ID prefix. No vaporware detected, but absence of code links for 10/11 means real-world usability is unverified for those.
_summary: Banked 11 FRESH techniques: subfield A (diffusion/score for inverse problems & data assimilation) = 7, subfield B (Koopman/DMD/data-driven dynamical systems) = 4. Only 1 has explicit usable code (kooplearn 2512.21409).
